title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the model's complexity. Can you think about how increasing this penalty might affect the model's ability to fit the training data?

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: As the regularization coefficient lambda increases, the penalty for complexity becomes larger. Consider how this might influence the model's flexibility and its variance.

title: Variance and Regularization
text: What happens to the variance of a model when you increase the regularization coefficient lambda?
